title: Wrong collateral refund in liquidation when `liqPrice == priceAfterImpact`
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Low  ## Description  When a liquidation is triggered and the Oracle price used results in `liqPrice == priceAfterImpact` during the execution of `executeAutomationCloseOrderCallback()`, the system may incorrectly refund a portion of the user collateral - approximately equal to the `liquidationFee`.  This occurs due to a discrepancy in how `value` and `liqMarginValue` are calculated within the `getTradeValuePure()` function.
